Subject: Implementation constraints & next steps

Hi Marcus / Redwood team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move forward but wanted to surface three technical constraints on our side before we lock dates:

1) Network: our security team requires an allowlist-based setup; we need a list of outbound IPs and an ETA for a static egress option.
2) Data residency: PHI must remain in us-east-1; can you confirm the Private deployment options & KMS key controls?
3) Staging access: we need a staging environment that mirrors production token limits for load testing (approx 3k concurrent requests).

We've attached an initial SOW for reference (MedLinc_SOW_v1.pdf). Procurement will also need the standard SOC2 evidence and a brief summary of your logging/audit capabilities.

Can we schedule a 30-min alignment tomorrow to confirm the checklist and nominate an implementation owner?

Best,
Clara
Director of Engineering, MedLinc

Clara — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned and appreciate you flagging these early. Quick responses below and next steps: 

- IP / Network: Redwood Dedicated can provide static egress IPs. I'll attach the current allowlist export and ask networking to produce the formal CIDR block list by EOD tomorrow (attached: network_requirements.xlsx).
- Data residency & KMS: Private deployment in us-east-1 is available; we support customer-managed KMS keys for encryption at rest. I'll share the KMS integration checklist in the follow-up.
- Staging concurrency: we can provision a staging pool sized for ~3k concurrent requests; we'll propose an acceptance load test plan during the kickoff.

I've nominated Vanessa Ortiz (CS Lead, Implementation) as the owner for this engagement to lead the kickoff and run the mutual action plan. Vanessa — can you confirm availability for a 30-minute alignment slot tomorrow (Wed 6/13) and take point on the SOW redline with Clara & Procurement?

I've also attached our internal redline template (SOW_medlinc_redline_v2.docx) for your review.

Thanks — Marcus Lin
